## Verification checklist

- [ ] Server and column collations checked (`SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('Collation')`, `sys.columns`)
- [ ] Effective model dumped and diffed with `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS`
- [ ] `ToQueryString()` / logs show no `nvarchar` parameter against `varchar` columns
- [ ] Actual plans captured for each high/medium finding (before and after)
- [ ] `SET STATISTICS IO ON` reads compared before and after
- [ ] Correctness fixes covered by a row-count or round-trip test
- [ ] Any column type change reviewed as a migration
